verdict.rationale: Ramp documents real-time auto-categorization and sync of coded transactions to ERP/accounting systems (ramp-docs-5, ramp-docs-15, ramp-intdir-1) and a broad accounting integration directory, positioning this as replacing manual journal entries. However, the evidence is entirely vendor-sourced marketing copy with no technical detail on sync direction, conflict resolution, or true bidirectionality (e.g., does Ramp pull back GL changes made in the ERP?), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of ERP sync reliability. Missing for 10: independent verification of bidirectional sync behavior, technical documentation of sync architecture/latency, and evidence of how conflicts or ERP-side edits are handled.
